The Rocky Horror Puppet Show: An Improvised Musical 

A Felted Take on a Cult Classic! 
Come celebrate Halloween with Puppet Bucket & our hit show extravaganza, Rocky Horror Puppet Show: An Improvised Musical! This show is an improvised musical that follows a goody two shoes small town couple who take a very wrong (or maybe perfectly right) turn and stumble into a bizarre, otherworldly cast of characters. With puppets, a cult classic horror flair, and singing. This show leans into the seductive absurdity of transformation, self identity, and giving into your deepest desires. Designed for those who appreciate camp, chaos, and cult-classic energy, Rocky Horror Puppet Show invites you to cheer, laugh, and maybe even question what’s pulling your strings.

In true Rocky Horror Picture Show fashion, pre-ordered ticket holders will receive an exclusive prop bag, so grab your tickets now! This show is recommended for audiences 18+.

Puppet Bucket is an award-nominated puppetry troupe bringing bold, story-driven theatre to life, one puppet at a time. We combine classic puppet charm with quick witted, narrative improv. We were honored with a B. Iden Payne Award nomination in 2025 and an Austin Chronicle Best of Arts and Entertainment 2026 nomination, both celebrating our distinct voice in Austin’s theatre scene. Find us on instagram @puppet.bucket!

Nocturnal Creatures Troupe presents: The Unsolved Mystery of Ms. Patsy Climb
An absurd puppet musical exploring the lives of three misfits on their quest to make it as street performers in the French Quarter of New Orleans. The Trio gets into all sorts of shenanigans, from getting addicted to “Crusties Hotdog Stand” , to refuting allegations of eating an ex lovers head. The story is narrated by Detective Bark, who uses his keen senses and logical mind to sniff out clues from the baffling events that have occurred.  Will the creatures find fame? Or will struggles between the bandmates stop them from getting picked up by a label? Is their lead glockenspiel a blood thirsty diva? Will Detective Bark be able to crack this case wide open, and earn the title “GOOD BOY”? All these questions answered and more in The Nocturnal Creatures Show!!
 
Bio:
Nocturnal Creatures Troupe is a collaboration between artists Krystal Burns (Sweet Oddity) and Omer Gal (Cookie Tongue) spinning absurd tales of three nocturnal misfits, in the format of a puppet musical. Gal and Burns are established artist/performers/musicians and puppeteers, having performed at many festivals, venues and shown work in galleries, namely New Orleans Puppet Festival, Asheville Fringe Arts, and many more. They both love story telling through songwriting, puppetry and pulling imagination in from the otherside. Nocturnal Creatures Troupe aims to transport the audience out of the hum-drum drag of everyday life into the spirit of absurdity, joy and laughter, and to inspire creativity in the heart of every audience member.

Come on out to Recycled books to meet local author of some of our favorite spine tingling thrillers, Brittney Kristina! Brittney will be selling and signing books inside of Recycled Books and Records on the downtown Denton square.

Brittney Kristina is the author of Forsaken, Fifty Days, the creative nonfiction and short story collection Hummingbird Tales, and most recently, The Unwavering Ache. She earned her dual bachelor’s degree in psychology and English from the University of North Texas. She is currently attending Texas A&M Kingsville for her master’s in Clinical Mental Health Counseling. 
A runner and lover of the great outdoors, Brittney can be found stepping out for a long run on a crisp morning, visiting a new park for a beautiful hike, or winding down at a yoga class. She is an avid reader of nearly every genre and, while reading, can be seen with a fragrant cup of tea or a delicious coffee by her side. She is working on draft 4 of her horror novel, Otherside, set to be released in 2027.

fields.Detailed Overview:
Spirited Forest Bathing: A Spooky Halloween Forest Therapy Experience

This isn’t your average walk in the woods… 👻 As twilight falls and shadows grow longer, join Sandy McEwan for Spirited Forest Bathing, a magical—and slightly spooky—Halloween-inspired forest bathing beneath the moonlit canopy.

Led by Sandy McEwan, Certified Forest Therapy Guide and yoga instructor, this enchanting evening combines mindful movement, nature meditation, breath awareness, and guided forest therapy invitations to help you slow down, release everyday stress, and reconnect with the natural world.

But as the sun disappears, the forest takes on a different feeling…

As darkness deepens, we’ll venture into the eerie beauty of the woods, tuning into mysterious sounds, rustling leaves, nighttime scents, shifting shadows, and the secrets hiding among the trees. With Halloween as our inspiration, we’ll explore the forest through the senses while embracing a little spooky, haunted, and otherworldly atmosphere.
Keep your senses alert—you never know what you might hear in the darkness… or what might be watching from the trees. 🌲👀

This isn’t a haunted house or a terrifying fright night. Instead, it’s a bewitching blend of mindfulness, nature connection, Halloween magic, and just enough mystery to make you wonder what lurks beyond the trail.

As our spooky forest adventure comes to an end, we’ll gather for an enchanted tea ceremony and forest-inspired seasonal snack, creating a cozy moment of warmth and reflection after our twilight wander.

What to Expect
•	🌲 Guided forest bathing
•	🧙‍♀️ Halloween-inspired mindfulness and nature meditation
•	🌙 A moonlit or twilight forest experience
•	🍂 Gentle yoga-inspired movement and breath awareness
•	👻 Spooky sensory invitations and mindful exploration
•	🌫️ Eerie sounds, mysterious shadows, and nighttime nature
•	🔮 An enchanting, slightly haunted atmosphere
•	🫖 Enchanted tea ceremony
•	🍄 Forest-inspired seasonal snack
•	🎃 Halloween magic, without the jump scares

Whether you’re searching for a unique Halloween experience, a spooky date-night activity, a peaceful alternative to a haunted house, or simply a chance to experience forest bathing after dark, Spirited Forest Bathing invites you to step off the beaten path and into a world of shadows, spirits, mystery, and magic.

Come commune with nature—and perhaps a few forest spirits—for an unforgettable evening of Halloween enchantment, spooky forest exploration, mindfulness, and forest therapy.

Enter if you dare… the forest is waiting. 🎃🌲👻

A Denton tradition celebrating trucks, community and giving!

Since 2016, the Peterbilt Pride & Class Parade has brought truck enthusiasts from across the United States and Canada to Denton for an unforgettable celebration of custom Peterbilt trucks and community spirit. More than 50 impressive trucks make their way through the streets of Denton, culminating in a spectacular parade route through the historic Denton Square.

Held annually on the third Friday of October, this family-friendly event is a must-see for truck enthusiasts and families alike. Bring your lawn chairs, gather your family and friends, and enjoy a fun-filled evening on the Square as these one-of-a-kind trucks roll through downtown Denton.

But the Pride & Class Parade is about more than trucks - it's about giving back. Donations from the event support Peterbilt's United Way employee giving campaign, helping make a difference for individuals and families throughout Denton County.

Peterbilt's partnership with United Way of Denton County spans decades. Peterbilt has supported United Way since the 1980s and, since 2002, the partnership has helped raise over $10 million to support the Denton County community. Each fall, Peterbilt employees come together for a week of fundraising, friendly interdepartmental competition and special events - all leading up to the annual Pride & Class Parade.

Come for the trucks. Stay for the fun. Give for the community.

Ready, set, SPLAT! 

The City of Denton invites you to the family-friendly Blocktober Party & Pumpkin Drop, an evening of fun, community connection, and a spectacular kickoff to our month‑long Halloween programming.

Join us on Thursday, Oct. 1, at the Quakertown Civic Center (321 E. McKinney St.) for a combined block party and pumpkin drop event designed to bring residents together and offer a behind‑the‑scenes look at the people and services that keep Denton running.

Meet local officials and City staff, including police officers, firefighters, and Council members. It’s a great opportunity to ask questions, explore City services, and learn about upcoming initiatives.

The evening will be packed with activities for all ages. Watch pumpkins filled with all kinds of foods soar and SPLAT from dizzying heights. Visit booths hosted by City departments featuring helpful information and interactive games covering everything from public safety to parks and recreation.

Families can enjoy bounce houses, lawn games, and the popular “touch‑a‑truck” exhibit, where kids can get a close look at City vehicles. Food trucks will also be onsite with tasty options available for purchase.

Whether you're a lifelong horror fan or just looking for a fun Halloween tradition, this is an experience you won't forget.

⚠️ Warning: Some flashing light sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

💬 Have questions? Send us a message on Facebook!

🚫 If you'd rather not interact with our monsters, simply keep your windows up and doors locked. Please be kind to our performers—they're here to make the experience unforgettable! If you're feeling overwhelmed, just let them know, and they'll move on to the next brave vehicle.

fields.Detailed Overview:
Playwright Steven Dietz reanimates one of literature’s most enduring legends, bringing Dracula to the stage with striking energy and gothic allure. Drawing inspiration from Bram Stoker’s classic novel, this adaptation blends lyrical storytelling with vivid theatrical moments, creating a haunting experience that is both intimate and sweeping in scale.

As a mysterious figure from Eastern Europe arrives in London, a strange unease spreads among its residents. Unexplained encounters, shifting shadows, and whispered fears begin to connect, revealing the presence of a powerful and merciless force. A determined circle of allies must unravel the truth before they, too, fall under the Count’s dark influence.

By turns eerie, romantic, and unexpectedly wry, this retelling captures the complexity of Dracula’s legend—the terror he inspires and the tragedy he embodies. Step into a world where danger and desire intertwine, and brace yourself for a night of suspense, intrigue, and unforgettable horror.

          Written by: Steven Dietz
          Director: Ella Schrack-McPhee
          Run time: 2 hours with a 15-minute intermission

ALL NIGHT LONG: Build Your Own Cat Toy Station!

9PM-10PM: The Hissy Kits Purrformance!
Have a seat and experience the most magical purrformance of your lifetime. These two kittens have traveled all the way from up north with their piano and theremin to give us a night we'll never forget!

10PM: Flea Market
The Hissy Kits as well as some other vendors will have some amazing cat themed goodies they'd love to sell to you! All cat themed of course!

There once was a cat with no fears
Who spoke limericks on stage with a few beers
They got a little too cocky
Fell off stage "What a shocky!"
And left with eight lives left and a "Cheers!"

After 10pm: Cat Walk/Costume Contest

We're turning the lights down low for all you nocturnal kitty cats out there! Grab your little cat toy you created earlier in the evening and wave them around in the dance lights! We're getting FRISKY in here!
Sound like the best night of your life? The seating is limited, so grab those tickets ASAP!
THIS EVENT IS 21+ AND A QUEER FRIENDLY SPACE.

fields.Detailed Overview:
Playwright Steven Dietz reanimates one of literature’s most enduring legends, bringing Dracula to the stage with striking energy and gothic allure. Drawing inspiration from Bram Stoker’s classic novel, this adaptation blends lyrical storytelling with vivid theatrical moments, creating a haunting experience that is both intimate and sweeping in scale.

As a mysterious figure from Eastern Europe arrives in London, a strange unease spreads among its residents. Unexplained encounters, shifting shadows, and whispered fears begin to connect, revealing the presence of a powerful and merciless force. A determined circle of allies must unravel the truth before they, too, fall under the Count’s dark influence.

By turns eerie, romantic, and unexpectedly wry, this retelling captures the complexity of Dracula’s legend—the terror he inspires and the tragedy he embodies. Step into a world where danger and desire intertwine, and brace yourself for a night of suspense, intrigue, and unforgettable horror.

          Written by: Steven Dietz
          Director: Ella Schrack-McPhee
          Run time: 2 hours with a 15-minute intermission

Oct. 8 — Killer Klowns from Outer Space

fields.Detailed Overview:
Playwright Steven Dietz reanimates one of literature’s most enduring legends, bringing Dracula to the stage with striking energy and gothic allure. Drawing inspiration from Bram Stoker’s classic novel, this adaptation blends lyrical storytelling with vivid theatrical moments, creating a haunting experience that is both intimate and sweeping in scale.

As a mysterious figure from Eastern Europe arrives in London, a strange unease spreads among its residents. Unexplained encounters, shifting shadows, and whispered fears begin to connect, revealing the presence of a powerful and merciless force. A determined circle of allies must unravel the truth before they, too, fall under the Count’s dark influence.

By turns eerie, romantic, and unexpectedly wry, this retelling captures the complexity of Dracula’s legend—the terror he inspires and the tragedy he embodies. Step into a world where danger and desire intertwine, and brace yourself for a night of suspense, intrigue, and unforgettable horror.

          Written by: Steven Dietz
          Director: Ella Schrack-McPhee
          Run time: 2 hours with a 15-minute intermission

Join us for the opening reception of The Legend of Eppy and Other Artifacts of Lore on Friday, October 2 from 6 p.m. - 8 p.m. to explore the history of some of the strangest and most bizarre objects in UNT Special Collections. This is one “lore drop” you won’t want to miss.

Every artifact has a story, and sometimes the story is so creepy, weird, or fascinating it becomes lore.

Like the apocalyptic paintings made by a Sunday school teacher in Denton to scare kids straight, or the tiny skull kept by a boy who loved his pet hamster, Mildred, so much he could never say goodbye. This exhibit explores the concept of lore through the artifacts we leave behind, like photographs of the infamous “Wyooter” cryptid, and a book so small it caused the typesetter to go blind.

No artifact in Special Collections has such an inspired lore as Eppy, an infamous former mascot that was lost, found, stolen and returned with a suspicious injury. Countless Reddit threads document student’s search for Eppy. Abandoned after his retirement in the mid-1990’s and relegated to a stairwell in the Union, students sought out and ultimately saved this creepy, but beloved, piece of history.

The exhibition will be on view from October 1 - 31.

Our Pumpkin Patch is a fun, family-friendly fall tradition filled with pumpkins of all shapes and sizes, festive photo opportunities, and plenty of space to enjoy the season with family and friends. fields.Detailed Overview:
Celebrate fall with us at the Trinity United Methodist Church Pumpkin Patch in Denton!

Our Pumpkin Patch is a fun, family-friendly fall tradition filled with pumpkins of all shapes and sizes, festive photo opportunities, and plenty of space to enjoy the season with family and friends. Whether you’re searching for the perfect carving pumpkin, decorating your front porch, snapping fall photos, or simply looking for a festive place to spend an afternoon, we would love to welcome you to the patch.

The Pumpkin Patch opens Sunday, September 20 and continues through October 31.

Hours:
Monday–Saturday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM
Sunday: 12:00 PM–7:00 PM

Throughout the season, Trinity will also host special activities and opportunities for our community to gather, including our Trunk or Treat celebration on Saturday, October 24 from 5:00–7:00 PM.

Admission to the Pumpkin Patch is free, and visitors are welcome to come take pictures and enjoy the patch even if they are not purchasing a pumpkin. Pumpkins are available for purchase in a variety of sizes and styles.

Proceeds from the Pumpkin Patch help support the Youth, Children's and Music ministries of Trinity United Methodist Church.

Bring your family, invite your friends, take some fall pictures, pick out a pumpkin, and enjoy a little bit of autumn right here in Denton. We can’t wait to welcome you to the Trinity Pumpkin Patch!

👻🚗 This isn't your ordinary car wash—it's a one-of-a-kind haunted drive-thru experience! From the moment you arrive, mysterious figures, eerie scenes, unsettling sounds, and terrifying surprises will surround your vehicle while you enjoy the safety of staying inside your car. And yes... we'll still have free candy until you scream for mercy! 🍬

🧙‍♀️📸 Bring the kids in their favorite Halloween costumes and grab photos with our creepy cast before or after your trip through the Tunnel of Terror!

🌙✨ Our entire property and wash tunnel will be transformed into a chilling tribute to horror cinema with immersive sets, haunting characters, fog, music, lighting effects, and plenty of surprises around every corner. Whether you're a lifelong horror fan or just looking for a fun Halloween tradition, this is an experience you won't forget.

⚠️ Warning: Some flashing light sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

💬 Have questions? Send us a message on Facebook!

🚫 If you'd rather not interact with our monsters, simply keep your windows up and doors locked. Please be kind to our performers—they're here to make the experience unforgettable! If you're feeling overwhelmed, just let them know, and they'll move on to the next brave vehicle.

🎃 Gather your bravest passengers and experience Tunnel of Terror VIII: Icons of Horror... where the legends never stay on the screen.

Playwright Steven Dietz reanimates one of literature’s most enduring legends, bringing Dracula to the stage with striking energy and gothic allure. Drawing inspiration from Bram Stoker’s classic novel, this adaptation blends lyrical storytelling with vivid theatrical moments, creating a haunting experience that is both intimate and sweeping in scale.

As a mysterious figure from Eastern Europe arrives in London, a strange unease spreads among its residents. Unexplained encounters, shifting shadows, and whispered fears begin to connect, revealing the presence of a powerful and merciless force. A determined circle of allies must unravel the truth before they, too, fall under the Count’s dark influence.

By turns eerie, romantic, and unexpectedly wry, this retelling captures the complexity of Dracula’s legend—the terror he inspires and the tragedy he embodies. Step into a world where danger and desire intertwine, and brace yourself for a night of suspense, intrigue, and unforgettable horror.

          Run time: 2 hours with a 15-minute intermission

You are invited to travel back in time at Mexican Oak as it is reimagined into the Haunted Lacy Hotel! The Lacy Hotel was the 1st building built right where Mexican Oak stands! It was also the 1st hotel and known for one of the best places to eat in Denton. So for the haunting details...... A known outlaw Sam Bass worked at The Lacy hotel.It was said that one of his associates may have been responsible for the tragic fire that burned the hotel down in 1884, taking with it one of the last known survivors of the Texas Revolution! Then it get's spooky, in 1924 The May building, that was built where the Lacy once stood also burned to the ground. With these tragic misfortunes many say you can still feel the restless souls affected by these events. So, travel back with us to bellhops, southern belles, gentleman and carpetbaggers. Too bad all they can do is haunt us... you'll have to come visit and see if you catch a haunting glimpse in to The Lacy's background, be greeted by a zombified bellhop or be served by a long dead server. You never know what you may experience around every corner.

Some examples of themes: honoring a loved one’s memory or honoring someone living. This is a great way to remember or honor a pet! Sugar skulls and Frida Kahlo are popular themes. The shrine can be built as a muse, or you can come up with your own idea!

The annual Denton Dig It! Archeology Fair is on Saturday October 17, 2026 from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Denton County Historical Park!

Spend the day learning and observing how archeologists sift through evidence to reveal human stories from near and ancient times! 

Sample Fair exhibits include geo-archeology, log cabin restoration, a blacksmith, historical documents, currency and maps, and hands-on activities provided by the North Texas Archeological Society.

This family friendly Fair is held at the Denton County Historical Park, 317 W. Mulberry St. in Denton, 76201. The Park faces Carroll Blvd. Adjacent to the Fair is the weekly Denton Community Market.

Denton Dig It! is a Texas Archeology Month event sponsored by the Denton County Historical Commission and the Denton County Office of History and Culture.

🎃👻 GET READY FOR OUR 7TH ANNUAL TRUNK OR TREAT! 👻🎃

It’s officially spooky season, and one of our favorite community traditions is BACK for its 7th year! Join us for a Halloween celebration filled with candy, costumes, games, activities, local vendors, and plenty of family-friendly fun!

📍 Where: Club Pilates Teasley Commons — 3220 Teasley Lane, Denton, TX 76210
📅 When: October 16, 2026
⏰Time: 4:30pm-7:30pm
💰 FREE to attend | Fun for all ages!

 👻 WHAT IS TRUNK OR TREAT?

Instead of trick-or-treating door-to-door, families can stroll through a parking lot filled with creatively decorated cars, each transformed into its own Halloween-themed experience! 🎃

Every “trunk” brings something different — from candy and games to prizes, giveaways, and spooky surprises. It’s a fun, family-friendly way to celebrate Halloween while bringing our local community together!

🎃 WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

🍬 Decorated Trunks — Explore creative Halloween-themed trunks filled with candy, games, prizes, and giveaways!

🎪 Local Vendors & Businesses — Shop, connect, discover new local businesses, and enjoy offerings from some of our amazing community partners!

🎨 Halloween Activities — Enjoy fun, hands-on activities and creative stations throughout the event.

👻 Costume Contest — Come dressed to impress for your chance to win a prize!

🎃 Pumpkin Decorating Station — Get creative and make your own Halloween masterpiece!

💀 Crazy & Creepy Hair Decorating — Add a little extra spooky flair to your Halloween look!

🪄 Bounce Houses — Let the kids jump, play, and burn off some of that candy-fueled energy!

🎟️ Raffles & Giveaways — Enter for your chance to win exciting prizes, services, and goodies from our participating businesses!


🧡 SUPPORTING OUR LOCAL COMMUNITY

Our Trunk or Treat is more than just a Halloween event — it’s a celebration of the Denton community!

We’re proud to bring together local businesses, organizations, families, and community members to create a fun, welcoming, and memorable experience for everyone. Our vendors and community partners play a huge part in making this event possible, and we’re so excited to continue growing this tradition year after year!


🎪 LOCAL BUSINESSES — JOIN US!

We’re still accepting local businesses and vendors who would like to be part of the fun!🎃

Whether you’re a small business, local organization, service provider, or community group, we’d love to have you join us and connect with hundreds of local families while helping us make this year’s Trunk or Treat the best one yet!

Interested in becoming a vendor or community partner? Send us a message to learn more and reserve your spot!


👻 COME CELEBRATE WITH US!

For seven years, our Trunk or Treat has brought families and local businesses together for a Halloween celebration that is safe, welcoming, and full of community spirit.

So grab your costumes, bring your candy bags, invite your friends, and get ready for a morning full of candy, creativity, local businesses, and a whole lot of Halloween magic! 🎃👻✨

We can’t wait to celebrate our 7th Annual Trunk or Treat with you!

🎃 FREE EVENT • ALL AGES WELCOME • COSTUMES ENCOURAGED

Celebrate fall with us at the Trinity United Methodist Church Pumpkin Patch in Denton!

Our Pumpkin Patch is a fun, family-friendly fall tradition filled with pumpkins of all shapes and sizes, festive photo opportunities, and plenty of space to enjoy the season with family and friends. Whether you’re searching for the perfect carving pumpkin, decorating your front porch, snapping fall photos, or simply looking for a festive place to spend an afternoon, we would love to welcome you to the patch.

The Pumpkin Patch opens Sunday, September 20 and continues through October 31.

Hours:
Monday–Saturday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM
Sunday: 12:00 PM–7:00 PM

Throughout the season, Trinity will also host special activities and opportunities for our community to gather, including our Trunk or Treat celebration on Saturday, October 24 from 5:00–7:00 PM.

Admission to the Pumpkin Patch is free, and visitors are welcome to come take pictures and enjoy the patch even if they are not purchasing a pumpkin. Pumpkins are available for purchase in a variety of sizes and styles.

Proceeds from the Pumpkin Patch help support the Youth, Children's and Music ministries of Trinity United Methodist Church.

Bring your family, invite your friends, take some fall pictures, pick out a pumpkin, and enjoy a little bit of autumn right here in Denton. We can’t wait to welcome you to the Trinity Pumpkin Patch!

The Spirits of the Cantina


Step away from the crowds and into A Fine Cantina for The Spirits of the Cantina — a month-long celebration of Mexican legends, cocktails, food, and a little Halloween mystery.

Discover The Spirits Collection, five limited-edition cocktails inspired by Mexican legends and tradition: La Llorona, El Charro Negro, El Nahual, La Pascualita, and Las Ánimas.

Come hungry, too. October brings Barbacoa Tacos and our Pumpkin Spice Tres Leches Cake, alongside our menu of Mexican-inspired tapas.

Whether you’re visiting Denton for Halloween or already call it home, make Wild Cactus part of your October. Settle in, share a few plates, try a Spirit, and experience the cocktails, atmosphere, and warm hospitality of the cantina.

Come hungry. Try a Spirit. Stay awhile.

As part of Denton Halloween 2026, UNT’s School of Philosophical and Historical Inquiry and Denton's Harvest House are teaming up to bring the spooky chill of medieval ghost stories here to Texas. Join UNT students, staff, and faculty on the dark eve of Tuesday, October 20th, where, from 7-9 pm, they will regale you with tales of lost souls, menacing monks, haunted knights, and cold Viking spirits. Fortifying spirits (hot and cold) and beer will be on tap for those 21+, as well as a variety of non-alcoholic drinks. Come join us as the Public Humanities thrill and terrify you, the public. If you are interested in the unknown, the mysterious, the unexplainable, come… pull up a chair and a pint, and let the shadowy medieval past fill your veins with icy terror (and history).

You are invited to travel back in time at Mexican Oak as it is reimagined into the Haunted Lacy Hotel! The Lacy Hotel was the 1st building built right where Mexican Oak stands! It was also the 1st hotel and known for one of the best places to eat in Denton. So for the haunting details...... A known outlaw Sam Bass worked at The Lacy hotel.It was said that one of his associates may have been responsible for the tragic fire that burned the hotel down in 1884, taking with it one of the last known survivors of the Texas Revolution! Then it get's spooky, in 1924 The May building, that was built where the Lacy once stood also burned to the ground. With these tragic misfortunes many say you can still feel the restless souls affected by these events. So, travel back with us to bellhops, southern belles, gentleman and carpetbaggers. Too bad all they can do is haunt us... you'll have to come visit and see if you catch a haunting glimpse in to The Lacy's background, be greeted by a zombified bellhop or be served by a long dead server. You never know what you may experience around every corner.

The Plum Boys are an Electronic Rock Pop band, formed in 2020 and based in Fort Worth, Texas. Three of the members met while attending school at the Fort Worth Academy of Fine Arts and singing for the world renowned Texas Boys Choir. In their sophomore year of high school and during the pandemic, the boys decided to form a band to write and produce an album. In the final months of their senior year of high school in 2022, they completed their 1st debut album ‘SHE’ and landed a distribution deal through Smith Music out of Fort Worth, Texas.

Not long after the Boys began performing live they were asked to open for the 80’s new wave group ‘A Flock of Seagulls’ at TannaHills Tavern and Music Hall. They recently opened for Kid Bloom at the House of Blues in Dallas and Houston.

In 2024 The Plum Boys released their 4 song EP ‘Velvet’. Promotion included a summer tour in Fort Worth Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Missouri. Their new EP ‘ALIVE’ is set to release in February 2026, following its 3 singles. This new era of the band ushers in a new sonic landscape and mature tone for the band.

The Plum Boys are also one of the highest streaming artist on the city of Fort Worth’s Library streaming platform, Amplify817, and have remained on the 91.7 KXT local radio show rotation. They continue to perform locally and regionally while working on building their fan base.
